pokedexEntries.ru: PLUSLE always acts as a cheerleader for its partners. Whenever a teammate puts out a good effort in battle, this POKéMON shorts out its body to create the crackling noises of sparks to show its joy.

pokedexEntries.sa: When PLUSLE is cheering on its partner, it flashes with electric sparks from all over its body. If its partner loses, this POKéMON cries loudly.

pokedexEntries.frlg: It cheers on partners while scattering sparks from its body. It climbs telephone poles to absorb electricity.

pokedexEntries.em: It has the trait of cheering on its fellow POKéMON. By shorting out the electricity it releases from its paws, it creates pom-poms for cheering.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.
